payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?

access.q: How do I access the course?
access.a: By card, access opens as soon as the payment is confirmed; with the other payment methods, as soon as we have checked the receipt. It is for life, on your phone, tablet or computer.

abroad.q: Can I follow the course from outside Spain?
abroad.a: Yes. Everything is online, with lifetime access on phone, tablet or computer: you follow the course wherever you live. The rules, procedures and authorities covered are Spain's, where the development takes place.

invoice.a: Yes, an invoice can be issued on request after payment. Write to us with your order reference.

support.a: Our team answers by email and by phone or WhatsApp during office hours, and helps you with any technical issue.

modules.q: Do I have to buy everything at once?
modules.a: No. Modules are sold one by one, depending on where you are. Discounts grow with the number of modules, and full access remains the cheapest option per module.

projectType.q: Does it suit my type of project?
projectType.a: The course follows an open-market housing development, from the plot to after-sales. Much of the journey — land, permits, financing, construction, legalisation — is the same for commercial and mixed-use schemes. Subsidised housing adds requirements set by each region that are not covered in detail.

whatIs.q: What is a real estate development course and what will I learn?
whatIs.a: It is training that explains how to develop housing from start to finish. In CONSTRUYE you go through the 12 phases: plot, feasibility, design, licences, financing, construction, sales, legalisation, handover and after-sales.

needExperience.q: Do I need experience, a degree or a lot of capital to be a property developer?
needExperience.a: The law does not require a specific qualification to be a developer. The capital you need depends on each project: the financing module and the course's templates teach you to work it out before you commit.

stepByStep.q: How is a housing development done, step by step?
stepByStep.a: You start with the plot and its planning analysis, work out the feasibility, commission the design, apply for the licences, finance and build. Then you sell, legalise the works, hand over the keys and look after after-sales. The course develops each step.

anyProvince.q: Is the course valid for any province in Spain?
anyProvince.a: Yes. It includes the state rules, a directory of partners for all 52 provinces and an annex with the tax and planning rules of each autonomous community.

roles.q: What is the difference between a developer, a builder and an estate agent?
roles.a: The developer decides on, drives and finances the works and is liable to the buyer. The builder carries them out and the agent sells. In a small development one person can take on several roles, and the course explains the responsibilities of each.

company.q: Can I develop through a limited company?
company.a: Yes, it is the usual way to develop. Since Ley 18/2022 an S.L. can be set up with a capital of 1 euro, under conditions. The course explains how to set up the development company.

templates.q: Which templates does the course include?
templates.a: Five calculation templates, included: plot purchase, feasibility and residual method, developer loan, construction cost control, and sales and collections plan. At the end of the course you can add, as an extra, a professional's complete financial model: 18 sheets, more than 30,000 formulas and taxes up to date.

whyNow.title: Why now? — Because Spain needs more housing than it builds.
whyNow.quote: Spain is short of homes, prices are rising and the State has approved a €7 billion plan to boost supply.
whyNow.k1: The demand already exists: some 223,000 households are formed every year.
whyNow.k2: The sector is already responding: from 139,000 homes started in 2025 to 153,000 in 2026.
whyNow.k3: There is public support: the State plan gives priority to new construction.
whyNow.close: The opportunity is not automatic: the margin is won in the feasibility study.

method.title: From the plot to after-sales: the 12 phases of a development, explained step by step.
method.intro: The real order of a development, without skipping a phase:
method.s1: Plot: find plots, read the planning rules and buy without legal or planning surprises. With Template 1: plot purchase.
method.s2: Feasibility: work out cost, financing and margin before committing a single euro. With Template 2: feasibility and residual method.
method.s3: Technical projects: hire and coordinate the architect, the engineers and the site management.
method.s4: Licences: know which licence to apply for, from whom, and what happens when the administration stays silent.
method.s5: Financing and contracting: set up the developer loan, the guarantees and the construction contract. With Template 3: developer loan.
method.s6: Construction: organise the works, the deadlines and the mandatory insurance.
method.s7: Construction control: watch progress valuations, quality and cost overruns. With Template 4: construction cost control.
method.s8: Sales: set the price and sell off-plan with the guarantees the law requires. With Template 5: sales and collections plan.
method.s9: Legalisation: close the completion of works, the new-building deed, the horizontal division and the occupancy certificate.
method.s10: Pre-handover: inspect the home with the buyer and fix things before handing it over.
method.s11: Handing over the keys: hand over with the paperwork in order and without disputes.
method.s12: After-sales and close-out: deal with warranties and claims, and close the development financially.
method.close: Each module tells you what to do, in what order, whom to turn to and which law applies. With practical checklists, calculation templates in the key modules, a quiz per module and a final exam.

maze.title: Capital is not enough. What stops projects is the paperwork.
maze.lead: You have the funds, perhaps even the plot. What blocks you comes afterwards.

costOfError.title: In a development, a mistake is not paid for in euros. It is paid for in months.
costOfError.close: The price of this course? What it would cost you to learn just one of these phases on your own site.
costOfError.e1Short: An incomplete licence: months of waiting with the land already paid for.
costOfError.e2Short: Taking payments without a guarantee: a breach of the law, and a bank that will not lend.
costOfError.e3Short: No OCT means no ten-year insurance, and no ten-year insurance means no new-building deed.
costOfError.e4Short: Without the new-building deed and the horizontal division registered, no home can be sold by separate deed.

financials.title: Financial template of the development
financials.lead: The corrected professional template (PLANTILLA_LIBRE_corregida.xlsx), calculated with its formulas and the iterative calculation already solved. You fill in the input data; the template calculates everything else, with the legal parameters in force.
financials.paramsNotice: What the law does not set (fees, OCT, ten-year insurance, valuations) keeps the original's values: ask for a current quote.
financials.locked: It is the extra at the end of the course: it is in no plan and is bought separately.

financials.notConverged: Warning: the iterative calculation did not settle in {{count}} iterations. Check the data.
financials.simplifiedHint: The "3ª Coste Total Promoción" sheet: it is the simplified feasibility template, with your data.
financials.originalsNote: If Excel warns of a «circular reference», check that iterative calculation is on (100 iterations, maximum change 0.001). In LibreOffice, recalculate several times (Ctrl+Shift+F9).
financials.mineNote: With your figures and the legal parameters in force. The formulas are intact and iterative calculation is on.

legalParams.title: Legal parameters applied
legalParams.readOnly: IVA, ITP, AJD and the rest of what the law sets: CONSTRUYE keeps them up to date and every template applies them. You only choose the autonomous community where the site is.

extra.eyebrow: The extra at the end of the course
extra.title: Take the next step: a professional's complete financial template
extra.body: You can already calculate a development with the course's templates. The professional template does it month by month and chapter by chapter: land, construction, external works, design, licences, loan, management, payment schedule and a 48-month cash flow. 18 sheets and more than 30,000 formulas, reviewed cell by cell, corrected and with your community's taxes up to date.

methods.title: Payment methods
methods.lead: We do not store any card: each payment is made there and then, with the method you choose.
methods.stripe: Paid on Stripe's secure page. Construye never sees or stores your card number.
